title: PR workflow
description: Wraps gh CLI to read PR/check status for the current branch; execute:wave:post writes a gate-readable PR.md report, ship:pre gates advisorily on it.

pr-workflow.enabled.description: Master toggle for the pr-workflow capability.

pr-workflow.ship_gate.description: When true, ship:pre advises (never blocks -- PRW-05 defers blocking to v2) on pr_gate_ok!=true in PR.md.

gates.description: Advisory only (PRW-02): PR.md's derived pr_gate_ok boolean is the gate target, never the raw four-state pr_status (single-scalar equals cannot express OR -- 14-RESEARCH.md Pitfall 1).
